### Wait for the Glory (Romans 8:18) - Your Daily Bible Verse - April 23
Author: Betsy St. Amant Haddox
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-daily-bible-verse/your-daily-bible-verse-april-23.html
Passage: Romans 8:18
Points:
- Earthly pain, grief, and declining health can feel overwhelming, but this life is not the final chapter.
- The trials believers endure are completely eclipsed by the future glory God will reveal.
- God promises believers future restoration, perfect bodies, and unbroken fellowship with Him.
- Christians can endure seasons of suffering with patient hope and confident expectation in God's promises.

### Praying for God's Will, Not Our Own (Romans 8:26) - Your Daily Bible Verse - August 18
Author: Joe McKeever
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-daily-bible-verse/praying-for-god-s-will-not-our-own.html
Passage: Romans 8:26
Points:
- Human weakness means believers frequently do not understand what or how to pray.
- Authentic prayer involves surrendering personal desires to God's sovereign will and wisdom.
- Delays or unexpected answers to prayer test and strengthen faith rather than signaling abandonment.
- God actively uses difficult and disappointing circumstances to prepare His people according to His plan.
